resources.string: Have you eaten something in the last 3 or 4 hours?
Have you drunk water in the last hour?
Do you need to go to the bathroom?
Have you slept or rested well?
Is there a lot of noise, light or people around you?
Have you just stopped something very stimulating? (social media, games, a hyperfocus, a social plan…)
This may be playing a part
Your body seems to be fine
The discomfort may come from somewhere else. Give yourself a moment:

string-array.name: body_tips_food
string-array.item: Something simple is fine: fruit, nuts, a yoghurt or a piece of toast.
Even if you do not feel hungry, try something small: sometimes hunger only shows once you eat.
Better with some protein (egg, cheese, pulses, nuts): the dip takes longer to come back.
Leave something to eat in sight for next time.

string-array.name: body_tips_water
string-array.item: A full glass now, in sips.
Keep the bottle in sight: out of sight, out of mind.
If plain water bores you, try a few drops of lemon or a cold infusion.

string-array.name: body_tips_bathroom
string-array.item: Go now: holding it in also affects your mood even if you do not notice.
Take the chance to wash your face with cool water.

string-array.name: body_tips_sleep
string-array.item: With little sleep everything is twice as hard: lower the bar for today.
If you can, 10 or 20 minutes lying down with your eyes closed help even if you do not sleep.
Tonight, put the screen away a while before bed.
Today is not a good day for big decisions: note them down for tomorrow.

string-array.name: body_tips_senses
string-array.item: Find a quieter place, even for a few minutes.
Headphones or earplugs, even without music.
Turn down the screen and room lights.
Close your eyes and breathe slowly while you count five breaths.

resources.string: After a lot of stimulation, normal things feel boring or irritating. It is a passing dip, not your fault.

string-array.name: body_tips_crash
string-array.item: Move for 5 minutes: walk, stretch or dance to one song.
Get some daylight or look out of the window for a moment.
Put on music you like while you do something simple.
Do not go back to the same stimulus to escape it: swap it for something calm for a while.
Pick a small task with a clear end: wash a mug, make the bed.
Eat or drink something if it has been a while.
Tell someone you trust: \"I am in a dip for a bit, it is not about you\".

resources.string: If it happens mostly when your medication wears off, talk to your doctor about it.
In the Sanctuary you will see a grid of sounds: tap to turn them on, combine them and set each volume. Your mix is saved.
A phrase every 30 seconds, with a slow fade. If you turn it off, you will only see \"This is your moment\".

string-array.name: sanctuary_phrases

Your brain goes fast. Here it can go slow.
This too will pass.
Breathing is enough for now.
You are not late for anything.
You can let your shoulders drop.
Nobody is waiting for you here.
What you feel is real, and it is temporary.
You do not need to understand everything to be okay.
You are allowed to stop.
The noise outside can wait.
You are safe in this moment.
One breath slower than the last.
You are not your thoughts. You are just hearing them.
What is pending will still be there. You come first.
Resting is also doing something.
The way you work is not a mistake.
Today can be a simple day.
It does not have to be perfect.
There is nothing to prove here.
Unclench your jaw.
Feel your feet on the ground.
One moment at a time.
Your worth does not depend on what you did today.
You are doing the best you can, and that is enough.
You can say no later. Right now, rest.
The rush does not come with you here.
What overwhelms you is not for now.
Let your thoughts pass like clouds.
You deserve the patience you give others.
You do not have to earn rest.
The silence is yours too.
If your mind wanders, come back without scolding yourself.
This space is just for you.
You do not need to feel like it to be okay for a while.
Your body knows how to calm down. Give it time.
The intensity fades. It always does.
Needing a pause is not failing.
Tomorrow does not have to be solved today.
You can start again whenever you want.
Small things count too.
You are here. That is enough.
Notice the air coming in and going out.
Nothing urgent fits in this moment.
You can be kind to yourself right now.
Going slowly is not going badly.
You have made it through hard days before.
You do not have to be at one hundred percent.
What did not get done today does not define you.
Stay as long as you need.
